scientific_scope.arm_development_gate: nominal smoke has a native accepted pose, full horizon and no fall/contact/nonfinite; inertial arm additionally actually initializes
scientific_scope.coordinate_epoch_policy: causal observed map identity unavailability/ID change, previously observed IMU initialization becoming unconfirmed, or return to NOT_INITIALIZED conservatively invalidates registration even if ID is reused; retained-identity transient tracking loss alone is not an invalidation
scientific_scope.epoch_metric_scope: wrapper observes map identity through usable tracked map points, not direct Atlas state; count logical registration invalidations separately from observed native ID changes, never as confirmed native resets
scientific_scope.execution_gate: all 14 same-source/input smoke cells execute with retained finite sensor/latency evidence; degraded outcomes remain scored
scientific_scope.false_free_metric: evaluator-only false-clear raw-brake packets against original same-time ray surfaces; no complete occupancy claim
scientific_scope.fault_negative_policy: do not require tracking/goals under smoke faults; scientific degradation never masquerades as runtime failure

initialization.known_start_assumption: first accepted pose anchored to nominal station, initialization movement not truth-corrected

scientific_scope.permanent_stop_policy: after first accepted epoch, any observed coordinate-continuity invalidation permanently rejects later poses
scientific_scope.planner_inputs: native accepted pose, prescribed route, nominal known start, shared measured raw LiDAR brake
scientific_scope.recovery_epoch_policy: native map ID recorded separately; logical monotone coordinate epoch is registration token; every new epoch requires unchanged three calibration plus three later validation observations, never LIO pose fallback
scientific_scope.scope: bounded matched development, no hardware or independent confirmation
scientific_scope.sensor_noise: ideal simulated cameras and IMU; three past-render exposure approximation, no hardware noise/shutter claim
scientific_scope.source_change_rule: new frozen source requires fresh complete smoke; never reuse outcomes from superseded source
